items.title: Ukrainian suspect in Nord Stream sabotage detained in Croatia
items.summary: Germany's federal prosecutor's office reported that a Ukrainian citizen suspected of involvement in the Nord Stream pipeline explosions has been detained in Croatia. The allegations have not been proven in court.

items.title: CSTO says Armenia retains security guarantees
items.summary: CSTO Secretary-General Taalatbek Masadykov said the organization is not considering expelling Armenia and that the country retains its security guarantees, despite tensions over its participation in the alliance.
